parameters.command:
=# Ensure session exists
tmux has-session -t n8n-{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.session_id }} 2>/dev/null || tmux new-session -d -s n8n-{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.session_id }}

# Markers
START_MARKER="CMD_START_$$_$(date +%s)"
END_MARKER="CMD_END_$$_$(date +%s)"

# Start marker
tmux send-keys -t n8n-{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.session_id }}:0 "echo $START_MARKER" C-m

# Write payload
PAYLOAD="{{ $json.payload }}"
FILE_NAME="{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.file_name }}"
tmux send-keys -t n8n-{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.session_id }}:0 "echo '$PAYLOAD' | base64 -d > $FILE_NAME" C-m

# Output file content
tmux send-keys -t n8n-{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.session_id }}:0 "cat $FILE_NAME" C-m

# End marker
tmux send-keys -t n8n-{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.session_id }}:0 "echo $END_MARKER" C-m

# Wait for end marker
while true; do
    sleep 0.5
    tmux capture-pane -pt n8n-{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.session_id }} > /tmp/tmux_output_$$
    if grep -q "$END_MARKER" /tmp/tmux_output_$$; then
        break
    fi
done
